QUOTE: "Cancel-flag poller | `src/inference/inference_c_api.cpp:385` | Bridges `int*` cancel to `std::atomic<bool>` at 10 ms"; "Generator observer | ... | Mirrors `interrupt_flag_` into the batch cancel int"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists the bridging threads but never states that they exist because the C ABI boundary cannot carry an atomic. The poller direction is also described as int* to atomic, the opposite of the item's atomic-to-plain-int bridge.
